blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.
blocks.zh: Code2Video使用代理授权的3D代理来引导视频生成,从而可以对结构和动态进行明确的控制. 然而,如何建立最佳下游质量的代理和激励机制,以及这一模式的能力和局限性,仍然没有得到充分利用。 通过有控制的实验和盲目的人类评价, 我们研究代用颗粒性, 物理模拟, 和催化。 结果揭示了任务依赖的权衡:粗糙的代理偏好自然运动,而中厚的代理偏好一致性. 物理模拟和代理对齐可进一步促进平均质量。 在这些发现的指引下,我们引入Coda-DaVinci,这是Code2Video生成的任务适应代理框架,在代理制导和直接生成之间进行选择,使模型颗粒性适应每个实体,并与代理制导的提示协调模拟. 其多代理设备通过目视检查和独立审查保存现场资产并指导修理。 实验显示在VTR上遵循的主要指示和R2M上的场景一致性,在直接生成上提高物理可信度,比比较的Code2Video基线更高的视觉现实性. 长视频评价进一步显示,在事件结构和连续互动的一致性方面有所进展,同时揭示了过渡稳定性和遵守现场环境方面的局限性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent video generation models can synthesize realistic and visually appealing videos from text and reference media [ 22 , 11 , 27 , 7 , 24 ] .
Yet following detailed instructions, preserving scene state over time, and producing physically plausible interactions remain challenging.
Code2Video approaches, including VideoCoCo [ 13 ] and Code Video Model [ 14 ] , address these challenges through executable scene programs.
In this paradigm, a coding agent constructs and renders a 3D proxy whose structure and motion guide a video model in synthesizing the final video. This explicit scene representation helps maintain scene state across camera revisits, as shown in Figure 1 (a).
blocks.zh:
近期的视频生成模型可以合成来自文本和参考媒体的现实和视觉吸引力视频[22、11、27、7、24]。
然而,遵循详细指示,随着时间的推移保持现场状态,并产生实际可行的互动,仍然是一项挑战。
Code2Video方法,包括VideoCoCo[13]和Code Video Model[14],通过可执行的场景程序来应对这些挑战.
在这个范式中,一个编码代理构建并使得一个3D代理在合成最终视频时其结构和运动指导一个视频模型. 如图1(a)所示,这种清晰的场景表现有助于保持场景状态跨镜头重访。

blocks.en:
The benefits of Code2Video depend on the task and on how the proxy is constructed and used.
Scene programs provide precise control over layout and trajectories, but detailed modeling can introduce geometric or motion errors that may carry over to the final video.
When motion naturalness is central and explicit scene control offers limited benefit, an imperfect proxy may yield less natural results than direct generation.
Proxies for the same task can differ substantially in their level of detail.
Physical interactions also require choosing between scripted motion and physics simulation.
The synthesis prompt must then align the intended appearance and finer actions with the rendered proxy.
These considerations raise two central questions: How can we achieve the best video generation performance within the Code2Video paradigm, and how far can Code2Video extend the capabilities of video generation?
blocks.zh:
Code2Video的好处取决于任务以及代理的构建和使用方式.
场景程序提供了对布局和轨迹的精确控制,但详细的建模可以引入几何或运动错误,这些错误可能延续到最后的视频.
当运动自然性是核心和明显的场景控制提供有限的好处时,不完善的代用可能产生的自然结果不如直接生成.
同一项任务的代名词在详细程度上可能大不相同。
物理相互作用还需要在脚本运动和物理模拟之间作出选择.
然后,合成提示必须使预期的外观和精细动作与所提供的代理一致。
这些考虑提出了两个核心问题: 如何在Code2Video范式内实现最佳视频生成性能,Code2Video能在多大程度上扩展视频生成能力?

blocks.en:
We study these questions through controlled comparisons with blinded human evaluation on tasks involving scene revisitation, complex motion, and physical processes.
The benefits of proxy guidance vary by task: improved consistency and instruction following can come at the cost of motion naturalness.
Under matched settings, coarse proxies preserve more natural motion than detailed alternatives on motion-intensive tasks, while medium-grained proxies provide stronger consistency when physics simulation is required.
Prompts written by the coding agent outperform the tested external enhancement strategy in pooled scores.
Among the tested configurations, medium-grained proxies combined with physics simulation and agent-authored prompts achieve the highest pooled performance.
blocks.zh:
我们研究这些问题的方法是,在涉及现场重访、复杂运动和物理过程的任务上,与盲目的人类评价进行有控制的比较。
代理指导的效益因任务而异:改进一致性和以下指示可以以运动自然性为代价。
在匹配的设置下,粗细的代理在运动密集任务上比详细的替代品更能保持自然运动,而中纹代理在需要物理模拟时提供更强的一致性.
编码代理撰写的提示在集合分数中超过了测试的外部增强策略.
在经过测试的配置中,中纹代号与物理模拟和代理授权的提示相结合,实现了最高的集合性能.

blocks.en:
Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci , a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation as shown in Figure .
Coda-DaVinci selects 3D modeling when precise scene or motion control is needed and favors direct generation for natural body movement when explicit control is unnecessary and proxy animation risks stiffness.
For modeled scenes, it uses medium-grained proxies for environments and structured objects, coarse proxies for human subjects, and Blender simulation for supported physical interactions, as shown in Figure 1 (b).
The agent inspects the proxy before writing a synthesis prompt that links appearance references to proxy entities and specifies finer human actions.
A multi-agent harness preserves the scene workspace across revisions and successive requests, supports visual inspection, and uses an independent acceptance agent to identify unmet requirements for repair.
blocks.zh:
根据这些发现,我们引入了Coda-DaVinci,如图所示,Coda-DaVinci是Code2Video生成的适应任务代理框架。
Coda-DaVinci在需要精确的场景或运动控制时选择3D模型,在明确控制没有必要和代理动画存在僵硬性风险时,倾向于直接生成自然体运动.
对于模型化的场景,如图1(b)所示,它对环境和结构化物体使用中纹代位,对人体主体使用粗代位,对支持的物理相互作用使用Blender模拟.
代理商在写出将外观参考物链接到代理实体的合成提示之前检查代理商,并指定更细的人类行动.
多代理牵引装置在修改和接连请求中保存现场工作空间,支持目视检查,并使用独立的验收代理识别未满足的维修要求.

blocks.en:
Experiments show that Coda-DaVinci leads the compared methods in instruction following on VTR [ 9 ] and scene consistency on R2M [ 6 ] .
It also improves physical plausibility over direct generation on World Models’ Last Exam in Physics [ 5 ] and outperforms Code2Video baselines in visual realism on the T2AV-Compass subset [ 2 ] , approaching direct generation.
We also examine agent–generator pairings and rendering engines; Blender offers higher quality than Three.js at greater token cost.
Long-video and multi-turn evaluations show gains in long-form structure and scene consistency over direct continuation, but lower transition stability and setting adherence.
blocks.zh:
实验显示,Coda-DaVinci在VTR[9]和R2M[6]上的场景一致性之后引导了指令中的比较方法.
它还在物理学世界模型的最后考试中改进了物理可信度,超过了T2AV-Compass子集[2]上的视觉现实主义中的Code2Video基线,接近直接生成。
我们还检查了代理发电机配对和渲染引擎;Blender以更高的象征性成本提供比Tree.j更高的质量。
长视频和多回合评价显示,在长形式结构和场景一致性方面比直接延续有所改进,但过渡稳定性较低,并确定了遵守情况。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are threefold: • We systematically analyze proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting, deriving task-dependent guidelines for proxy construction and video synthesis. • We introduce Coda-DaVinci , a task-adaptive agentic framework that coordinates selective 3D modeling and proxy-grounded synthesis, supported by a persistent scene workspace and visual feedback. • We empirically characterize Code2Video’s capabilities and limitations across tasks, agent–generator pairings, rendering engines, and long-video settings, revealing trade-offs in visual quality, consistency, and token cost.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献有三: 我们系统地分析代理颗粒性、物理模拟和催化,得出关于代理构造和视频合成的依赖任务的准则。 我们介绍Coda-DaVinci,这是一个任务适应剂框架,它协调选择性的3D建模和代理定位合成,辅以持续的场景工作空间和视觉反馈。 我们实证地描述Code2Video在任务、代理-生成者配对、渲染引擎和长视频设置方面的能力和局限性,揭示了视觉质量、一致性和象征性成本方面的权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Video Generation. Recent advances in video generation have substantially improved visual fidelity, motion quality, and text–video alignment [ 22 , 11 , 27 , 7 , 10 , 30 , 23 , 26 , 25 , 17 , 31 ] .
Building on this progress, recent work increasingly emphasizes reliable instruction following, spatiotemporal consistency, and physical plausibility.
TempAct [ 28 ] improves adherence to temporally complex instructions through planner–executor reinforcement learning.
To maintain visual consistency over longer sequences, Context Forcing [ 3 ] combines long-context supervision with slow–fast memory, while LongLive-RAG [ 8 ] retrieves previously generated video latents to mitigate identity drift.
MMPhysVideo [ 15 ] improves physical plausibility by jointly modeling RGB video with semantic, geometric, and trajectory cues.
Despite these advances, reliably following complex instructions, maintaining spatiotemporal consistency, and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging.

影视世代. 视频制作方面的最新进展大大改善了视觉忠诚、运动质量和文本-视频对齐[22、11、27、7、10、30、23、26、25、17、31]。
以这一进展为基础,最近的工作日益强调可靠的指导、瞬间的一致性和物理上的合理性。
Temple Act [28] 通过规划者-执行者强化学习,改善了对时间复杂指令的遵守.
为了在更长的序列中保持视觉一致性,上下文强制 [3] 将长文本监督与慢-快内存相结合,而LongLive-RAG [8] 检索以前生成的视频潜伏,以减轻身份漂移.
MMPhysVideo [15]通过将RGB视频与语义,几何和轨迹提示共同建模,提高了物理可信度.
尽管取得了这些进展,但可靠地遵循复杂的指示、保持时空一致性以及产生实际可行的动态仍然是挑战。

blocks.en:
Code2Video. Code2Video generation uses executable programs to control visual content and motion, enabling targeted editing.
The Code2Video framework [ 4 ] targets educational videos, and MoVer [ 19 ] guides motion graphics refinement through spatiotemporal verification.
StoryBlender [ 12 ] produces consistent 3D storyboards using persistent scene memory and engine-based verification, while SimWorlds [ 16 ] constructs dynamic Blender scenes through planning, coding, and verification.
For proxy-guided synthesis, GPT4Motion [ 18 ] uses Blender-simulated motion cues to guide diffusion models.
VideoCoCo [ 13 ] guides video generation with Blender-rendered spatiotemporal drafts, while Code Video Model [ 14 ] combines Three.js proxies with early-step conditioning to preserve structure and reduce synthetic-appearance leakage.
blocks.zh:
代码2Video. 代码2 视频生成使用可执行程序来控制视觉内容和运动,从而能够进行有针对性的编辑.
Code2Video框架[4]针对教育视频,MoVer[19]通过瞬间验证指导运动图形的完善.

对于代理制导合成,GPT4 Motion [18] 使用Blender-模拟运动提示来引导扩散模型.
VideoCoCo [13] 以Blender-resented sparotemporal 草稿来指导视频生成,而Code Video Model [14] 结合了Tree.js代词与早期步调,以保存结构,减少合成-出现泄漏.

blocks.en: Analyzed Components and Baselines. We analyze three design factors and combine their labels to denote experimental configurations (e.g., G1/P1/PE2 ). Implementation details are provided in the supplementary material. 1. Proxy granularity ( G ): G0 , G1 , and G2 denote coarse, medium, and fine geometry and motion, respectively. 2. Physics requirements ( P ): P1 requires Blender’s built-in physics simulation; P0 does not. 3. Prompt enhancement and proxy alignment ( PE ): PE0 applies no additional enhancement; PE1 uses MiniMax H3-Context-IR [ 20 ] to enrich the prompt; and PE2 requires the coding agent itself to specify subject–color bindings in the prompt and add complementary appearance details based on the constructed proxy. blocks.en: Evaluation metrics and protocol. Experts score each video on four dimensions under a blinded protocol using { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } \{0,1,2,3\} (higher is better). 1. Consistency: Temporal consistency within the generated video and consistency with the input reference. 2. Instruction following: The extent to which the generated video satisfies the input instruction. 3. Physical plausibility: The physical plausibility of the depicted motion, interactions, and processes. 4. Naturalness and visual realism: The perceived naturalness of motion and overall visual realism. The implementation details of the empirical analysis are in Appendix B.1 .

blocks.en: 3.4 Empirical Answers and Workflow Insights
blocks.zh: 3.4 经验答案和工作流程观察

blocks.en: The above empirical observations provide the following answers to the two central questions.
blocks.zh: 上述经验性观察对两个中心问题提供了以下答案.

blocks.en: Answers to the Central Questions 1. How far can Code2Video extend video generation? Code2Video most consistently improves consistency and instruction following over direct generation, with broader gains on scene revisitation and physical-process simulation. Its benefits remain task-dependent: complex human and object motion on VGIF-Bench still presents weaknesses in physical plausibility, naturalness, and realism. 2. How should the two models’ strengths be combined? Coding agents should specify essential scene structure and dynamics, while video-generation models realize appearance and fine motion. The strongest tested configuration, G1/P1/PE2 , combines medium-grained proxies, explicit physics simulation, and agent-guided prompt enhancement. The advantages of coarse proxies on motion-intensive tasks further motivate adapting the allocation of control to the task.
blocks.zh: 对中央问题的答复 1. Code2Video可以在多大程度上扩展视频生成? 代码2 视频在超过直接生成之后,最一贯地改进了一致性和教学,在现场重访和物理过程模拟方面取得了更广泛的收益。 其好处仍然取决于任务:VGIF-Bench上的复杂的人和物体运动仍然在物理可信性、自然性和现实性方面产生弱点。 2. 如何将两种模式的长处结合起来? 编码剂应具体说明基本场景结构和动态,而视频生成模型则实现外观和精细运动. 最强测试的配置G1/P1/PE2结合了中纹代位,显式物理模拟,以及剂导快速增强. 粗体代理动作密集型任务的优势,进一步激发了根据任务进行控制分配的动力.

blocks.en: How far can Code2Video extend video generation? Code2Video most consistently improves consistency and instruction following over direct generation, with broader gains on scene revisitation and physical-process simulation. Its benefits remain task-dependent: complex human and object motion on VGIF-Bench still presents weaknesses in physical plausibility, naturalness, and realism.

blocks.en: How should the two models’ strengths be combined? Coding agents should specify essential scene structure and dynamics, while video-generation models realize appearance and fine motion. The strongest tested configuration, G1/P1/PE2 , combines medium-grained proxies, explicit physics simulation, and agent-guided prompt enhancement. The advantages of coarse proxies on motion-intensive tasks further motivate adapting the allocation of control to the task.
blocks.zh: 如何将两种模式的长处结合起来? 编码剂应具体说明基本场景结构和动态,而视频生成模型则实现外观和精细运动. 最强测试的配置G1/P1/PE2结合了中纹代位,显式物理模拟,以及剂导快速增强. 粗体代理动作密集型任务的优势,进一步激发了根据任务进行控制分配的动力.

blocks.en: Workflow Design Insights. These findings motivate three coordinated workflow choices: adapt modeling and motion-control granularity to each entity, favoring coarse proxies for human motion and medium-grained proxies where structural consistency matters; selectively invoke Blender’s built-in physics engine for interactions the proxy can meaningfully simulate; and coordinate proxy construction with prompt enhancement by establishing subject–color bindings during modeling and explicitly describing these bindings alongside the proxy’s geometry, motion, and simulated behavior in the generation prompt.
blocks.zh: 工作流设计透视. 这些发现激励了三种协调的工作流程选择:将模型和运动控制颗粒性适应于每个实体,在结构一致性重要的地方偏好粗糙的人类运动代位和中纹代位;有选择地使用Blender的内置物理引擎进行代理可以有意义地模拟的相互作用;通过在模型制作过程中建立主题-色彩绑定,以及明确描述代位几何、运动和在生成时模拟行为来协调代理构建与快速增强。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
We introduce Coda-DaVinci , a task-adaptive agentic framework for code2video generation.
Coda-DaVinci selects a generation path based on task requirements and applies the corresponding modeling and prompting skills.
An execution harness coordinates scene construction and video synthesis, using visual feedback to guide revisions, as shown in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh:
我们介绍Coda-DaVinci, 用于代码2video生成的任务适应代理框架。
Coda-DaVinci根据任务要求选择一代路径,并应用相应的模型和提示技能.
如图5所示,利用视觉反馈来指导修改工作。

blocks.en: 4.1 Task-Adaptive Proxy Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务辅助建筑

blocks.en:
Route selection. Based on the input instruction and reference media, Coda-DaVinci selects 3D modeling for tasks requiring precise control over scene structure or motion.
For tasks centered on natural body movement, it selects direct video generation when explicit control is unnecessary and simplified proxy animation could introduce stiffness.
Both routes support video synthesis, with Blender tools additionally enabled for 3D modeling.
blocks.zh:
路线选择. 基于输入指令和参考介质,Coda-DaVinci为需要精确控制场景结构或运动的任务选择3D模型.
对于以自然身体运动为中心的任务,当明确的控制是不必要的,简化的代理动画可以引入僵硬性时,它会选择直接的视频生成.
两条路线都支持视频合成,Blender工具为3D建模额外启用.

blocks.en:
Modeling granularity. We encode the entity-wise policy from the preceding analysis in modeling skills: G1 for environments and structured objects, and G0 for human subjects.
The scene code specifies overall human movement, while the synthesis prompt describes finer actions.
The agent simulates requested physical interactions when they can be meaningfully represented in Blender.
blocks.zh:
建模颗粒性. 我们在模拟技能方面根据上述分析对实体政策进行编码:G1用于环境和结构化对象,G0用于人类主体。
场景代码指定了整体人类运动,而合成提示则描述了精细动作.
该剂在Blender能够有意义地表示时模拟请求的物理相互作用.

blocks.en: 4.2 Proxy-Grounded Video Synthesis
blocks.zh: 4.2 代理组合视频合成

blocks.en:
From proxy to synthesis prompt. After constructing the proxy, the agent inspects the rendered sequence and revises the scene code when the depicted events deviate from the request.
Guided by the synthesis skill, it then uses the inspected proxy to write a prompt describing the intended final video.
The prompt links subject descriptions to the corresponding proxy entities and appearance references, follows the actions depicted in the proxy, and specifies the visual details and subtle movements to be synthesized.
blocks.zh:
从代理到合成提示. 构建代理后,代理检查了渲染的序列,并在描绘的事件偏离请求时修改场景代码.
在合成技巧的指引下,它然后使用被检查的代理来写出一个描述预期最终视频的提示.
即时链接主题描述到相应的代理实体和外观参考,遵循代理中描绘的动作,并指定要合成的视觉细节和微妙动作.

blocks.en:
Video synthesis. Before synthesis, the harness checks that the proxy video and its shot description correspond to the same render and resolves subject references.
The generation tool then passes the prompt, proxy video, and associated reference media to the video model, which produces a candidate video.
The direct-generation path uses the same synthesis stage without a proxy, supplying a task-derived action and camera prompt with the available references.
blocks.zh:
视频综合. 在综合之前,利用检查代理视频及其镜头描述对应同一渲染度并解决主题参考.
生成工具随后将即时,代理视频,以及相关参考媒体传递到视频模型,该模型产生候选视频.
直接生成路径在没有代理的情况下使用相同的合成阶段,提供任务衍生的动作和带有可用引用的相机.

blocks.en: 4.3 Harness Design and Visual Feedback
blocks.zh: 4.3 机理设计和视觉反馈

blocks.en:
Workflow execution. The harness provides a shared Blender workspace and tool interfaces.
A lead generation agent coordinates execution and can delegate separable modeling tasks to coding subagents.
Each assignment specifies how a component should fit into the scene, and returned assets are then integrated and inspected in context.
The workspace preserves this work across revisions, allowing subagents to continue refining their components and supporting asset reuse in later video extensions.
blocks.zh:
工作流程执行。 吊带提供了共享的Blender工作空间和工具接口.
铅生成剂协调执行,并可将可分离的建模任务委托给编码子剂.
每项任务都规定一个部件应如何融入现场,然后根据具体情况整合和检查退回的资产。
工作空间在整个修改过程中保留了这项工作,允许子剂在以后的视频扩展中继续完善其组件和支持资产再利用.

blocks.en:
Visual feedback. Visual inspection covers both the proxy and the generated video.
For code2video outputs, the harness displays generated frames alongside the corresponding proxy views to help identify the source of discrepancies.
Proxy errors lead to scene revisions, while discrepancies introduced during synthesis guide changes to the prompt or reference inputs.
An independent acceptance agent reviews each candidate against the original task and its registered criteria.
The harness links the review to the submitted video and returns unmet requirements for repair.
blocks.zh:
视觉反馈. 视觉检查既包括代理,也包括生成的视频.
对于代码2video输出,在显示相应的代理视图的同时显示生成的框架,以帮助识别差异的来源.
代理错误导致场景修改,而综合指南中引入的差异则会改变即时输入或参考输入.
独立验收代理机构根据原任务及其登记标准审查每个候选人。
该工具将审查与提交的录像联系起来,并退回未满足的维修要求。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate Coda-DaVinci on World Models’ Last Exam in Physics [ 5 ] , R2M [ 6 ] , and VTR [ 9 ] for physical behavior, visual consistency, and detailed instruction following, respectively.
We further assess video realism and visual instruction following on 200 randomly sampled T2AV-Compass tasks [ 2 ] .
All methods use Seedance 2.5 [ 22 ] for video synthesis, with benchmark images supplied through the reference-media interface to ensure consistent input.
blocks.zh:
我们评价Coda-DaVinci在物理学世界模型的最后考试[5]、R2M[6]和VTR[9]的物理行为、视觉一致性和后面的详细指示。
我们进一步评估200个随机抽样的T2AV-Compass任务之后的视频现实主义和视觉指导. [2].
所有方法都使用种子2.5[22]进行视频合成,通过参考介质接口提供基准图像,以确保一致输入.

blocks.en:
Baselines. blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Coda-DaVinci leads on both instruction following and scene consistency. Coda-DaVinci achieves the highest scores across the reported VTR and R2M metrics and improves physical plausibility over direct generation. On VTR, it surpasses the strongest agentic baseline in checklist satisfaction and reduces WER from 59.21% for direct generation to 11.08%. These gains also extend to preserving scene structure and object states across views.
blocks.zh: Coda-DaVinci在指令之后和场景一致性上都领先. Coda-DaVinci在报告的VTR和R2M度量衡中取得了最高的分数,并且比直接生成提高了物理可信度. 在VTR上,它超过了清单满意度中最强的剂基数,并将WER从直接生成的59.21%降至11.08%. 这些成果还延伸到维护场景结构和各种观点的物体状态。

blocks.en: Explicit scene modeling strengthens physical fidelity. Each code2video method outperforms direct generation on World Models’ Last Exam in Physics. Coda-DaVinci ranks second to Claude + Blender, supporting the use of executable scenes for physical interactions. While claude also outperforms Codex with the same Blender tools, suggesting that the coding model’s ability to implement physical behavior contributes to the remaining performance gap.
blocks.zh: 清晰的场景造型加强了身体的忠诚. 每一种代码2video方法在物理学世界模型的最后考试中都超过了直接生成. Coda-DaVinci排名次于克劳德+Blender,支持使用可执行场景进行物理交互. 虽然Claude也以相同的Blender工具超越了Codex,但暗示编码模型执行物理行为的能力会助长剩余的性能差距.

blocks.en: Adaptive routing improves visual quality. On T2AV-Compass, Coda-DaVinci leads the code2video methods in realism and instruction following, with realism approaching direct generation and conventional agentic methods. This suggests that direct video generation of complex body motion reduces stiffness from proxy animation.
blocks.zh: 适应性路由提高了视觉质量. 在T2AV-Compass上,Coda-DaVinci在现实主义和指令上引导代码2video方法,现实主义接近直接生成和常规的代理方法. 这表明直接视频生成复杂的身体运动会减少代理动画的僵硬性.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Experiments
blocks.zh: 5.3 校验实验

blocks.en: We conduct the ablations on a 33-task diagnostic subset. Gemini 3.8 Flash scores each video from 1 to 5 on four dimensions: physical plausibility, instruction following, visual consistency, and joint aesthetics and fluency. All configurations use the same task-specific checklists, derived from the original instructions and references. We average the four scores to obtain the overall score.
blocks.zh: 我们用33个任务诊断子集 来做喷雾 双子座 3.8 Flash在四个维度上对每段视频从1到5进行评分:物理可信度,指令跟随,视觉一致性,以及关节美学和流利度. 所有配置都使用从原始指令和参考文献中衍生出来的相同的任务特定核对表. 我们平均得4分才能获得总分.

blocks.en: Coda-DaVinci is robust across coding agents. We evaluate Coda-DaVinci with four coding agents and three video generators in Table 5 . Overall scores remain similar across coding agents, suggesting that our task-adaptive design works with different models. The video generator also affects the result: Supplementary Material shows that even with correct proxy actions or camera movements, the video may deviate if the model does not follow the reference.
blocks.zh: Coda-DaVinci 横跨编码代理。 我们评价Coda-DaVinci, 总体的分数在编码剂之间仍然相似,说明我们的任务适应性设计与不同的模型不同. 视频生成器也会影响结果: 补充材料显示,即使有正确的代理动作或相机移动,如果模型不遵循参考,视频也可能偏离.

blocks.en:
Task adaptation and independent review improve video quality. We ablate three components in Coda-DaVinci with GPT-6-Astra and Seedance 2.5: independent acceptance, adaptive routing, and entity-wise modeling granularity. Each ablation lowers scores on all four dimensions as shown in Figure 6 (b). Independent acceptance is particularly useful for consistency, which drops most when this review is removed.
Fixing routing to 3D modeling in all tasks or applying G1 to all subjects has its largest effect on instruction following and aesthetics. These results suggest that fulfilling the task depends on both when to use explicit modeling and how much detail to represent.
blocks.zh:
任务调整和独立审查提高了视频质量。 我们用GPT-6-Astra和种子2.5在Coda-DaVinci中放弃了三个组件:独立接受、适应性路由和实体型模型颗粒性。 如图6(b)所示,每一次膨胀都会降低所有四个维度的得分。 独立接受对一致性特别有用,在取消审查时,一致性下降最多。
在所有任务中固定3D建模的路由或将G1应用到所有科目中,对跟随指令和美学影响最大. 这些结果表明,完成任务既取决于何时使用明确的模型,也取决于要说明多少细节。

blocks.en: Blender improves video quality at a higher token cost. We replace Blender with Three.js while keeping the coding agent and other settings fixed. As shown in Figure 6 (c), both modeling engines improve overall quality over direct generation. Blender scores higher on all four dimensions, suggesting that it provides a better basis for representing these tasks. It also consumes roughly twice as many agent tokens per case. Three.js thus offers a less costly option, with a modest loss in video quality on this subset.
blocks.zh: Blender以更高的象征性成本提高了视频质量. 我们用Tree.js替换Blender,同时保持编码代理和其他设置的固定. 如图6(c)所示,两种型号发动机都比直接发电提高了总体质量。 Blender在所有四个维度上的得分都更高,说明它为代表这些任务提供了更好的基础. 它的消耗量大约是每个病例的两倍。 因此,三.js提供了一个成本较低的选择,在这个子集上,视频质量略有损失。

blocks.en: 5.4 Long-Video Consistency Study
blocks.zh: 5.4 长视频一致性研究

blocks.en: A reusable 3D scene preserves objects and spatial relationships across clips, providing persistent memory for long-video generation.
blocks.zh: 可重复使用的3D场景保存了跨剪辑的物体和空间关系,为长视频生成提供了持续的内存.

blocks.en: We compare Coda-DaVinci with direct Seedance 2.5 on 29 LongAV-Compass and 50 WBench cases. LongAV-Compass sequences span 25–90 seconds and are generated event by event, using the preceding tail frame (T2AV/I2AV) or clip (V2AV) as reference. WBench evaluates successive interactions within a scene, with each turn continuing from the previous tail frame.
blocks.zh: 我们把Coda-DaVinci与29个LongAV-Compass和50个W Bench案件中的直接种子2.5进行比较。 LongAV-Compass序列跨度为25–90秒,按事件生成事件,使用前一个尾框(T2AV/I2AV)或片段(V2AV)作为参考. WBench评价一个场景内的连续相互作用,每个转弯都从之前的尾框继续.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 6 (d,e), Coda-DaVinci improves long-form structure on LongAV-Compass, with its largest WBench gains in interaction adherence and consistency. These findings support scene reuse for maintaining state across successive instructions. However, direct generation performs better in transition stability on LongAV-Compass and setting adherence on WBench, revealing remaining limitations in cross-clip continuity and scene fidelity.
blocks.zh: 如图6(d,e)所示,Coda-DaVinci在LongAV-Compass上改进了长式结构,其W Bench在相互作用的坚持性和一致性方面收益最大. 这些发现支持场景的再利用,以保持连续指令的状态. 然而,直接生成在LongAV-Compass上的过渡稳定性和在W Bench上的坚持性方面表现得更好,揭示了交叉剪切连续性和场景忠诚性方面仍然存在的限制。

blocks.en: 5.5 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5 定性分析

blocks.en: Scene modeling supports instruction following and state persistence. In Figure 7 , the camera is instructed to turn away from a person clearing leaves and then return to the steps. Seedance keeps the steps largely in view, with many leaves still present near the end. Both Codex + Blender and Coda-DaVinci complete the camera departure and return to cleared steps. The ongoing action therefore advances across the unseen interval and leaves a lasting change in the scene. This example illustrates how explicit modeling helps coordinate camera instructions with event progression while preserving the resulting state across a revisit.
blocks.zh: 场景建模支持遵循和状态持久性的指令. 在图7中,摄影机被指示离开一个人清除叶子,然后返回台阶。 种子基本上保持步骤的视线,许多叶子仍然在接近末端的地方. Codex + Blender 和 Coda-DaVinci 都完成了相机的离开并返回清除的步骤. 因此,正在进行的行动跨越了看不见的间隔,使现场发生了持久的变化。 这个例子说明了明确的建模如何有助于协调相机指令与事件进展,同时在一次回顾中保持结果状态.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Camera instruction following and state persistence. The camera turns away while leaves are being cleared, then returns to the steps. Each method occupies two rows, read consecutively from left to right. Frames are sampled at matching timestamps, with denser sampling during the return. Both code2video methods show cleared steps on revisitation, while Seedance retains substantial leaf coverage.
blocks.zh: 图7:相机指示跟随和状态持久性。 镜头在叶子清空时转过身来,然后返回台阶. 每种方法占两行,从左到右连续读取. 框架以匹配的时间戳进行取样,返回时采样密度较大。 两种代码2video方法都显示在重访时有清除步骤,而种子保留了大量的叶片覆盖.

blocks.en: Selective modeling preserves natural hand motion. Figure 8 compares a close-up of hands flattening dough. Codex + Blender keeps the hands in nearly the same pose throughout the sequence, giving the interaction a static appearance. In Coda-DaVinci, the wrists turn and the fingers adjust through successive presses as the dough changes shape. These coordinated changes make the action more fluid and the contact more convincing, retaining the lively motion visible in native Seedance generation. Here, Coda-DaVinci uses the Blender route: the result illustrates the value of leaving fine articulation to the video model while using the proxy to organize the interaction.
blocks.zh: 选择性的建模保存了自然的手动. 图8比较了特写手平面硬币. 代码 + Blender在整个序列中使手保持几乎相同的姿势,使相互作用呈现静态. 在Coda-DaVinci中,随着面团形状的改变,手腕转动,手指通过连续的按压调整. 这些协调的变化使动作更加流畅,接触更加令人信服,保留了在原生种子生成中可见的活性运动. 在此,Coda-DaVinci使用Blender路由:结果说明了在使用代理来组织互动的同时将精细的表达方式留给视频模型的价值.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Hand articulation and visual fluency. Consecutive frames from a dough-flattening task, sampled at 4 fps over 4.50–8.25 seconds. Each method occupies two rows, with the second continuing the first. Compared with the nearly fixed pose of Codex + Blender, Coda-DaVinci shows changing wrist and finger poses through repeated contact with the dough. Seedance provides the direct-generation comparison.
blocks.zh: 图8:手写和视觉流利。 以4.50至8.25秒的4英尺速率取样, 每种方法占两行,第二种继续第一行. 与Codex + Blender的近乎固定的姿势相比,Coda-DaVinci通过反复接触面团显示手腕和手指的姿势变化. 种子提供了直接生成的比较.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We investigated how coding agents and video-generation models can be coordinated within the Code2Video paradigm. Our analysis shows that effective proxy guidance requires matching modeling granularity, physics simulation, and prompting to task requirements. These findings inform Coda-DaVinci, which assigns essential structure and dynamics to coding agents while leaving appearance and fine motion to video models, supported by persistent scene assets and visual feedback. Experiments demonstrate leading performance on VTR and R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and further gains in long-form structure and consistency across successive interactions. Remaining gaps in motion naturalness, transition stability, and adherence to scene settings highlight the need to better preserve explicit control during synthesis as video generation extends to longer and more complex scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了如何在Code2Video范式内协调编码代理和视频生成模型. 我们的分析表明,有效的代理指导需要匹配模型颗粒性,物理模拟,并激励任务要求. 这些发现为Coda-DaVinci提供了信息,后者在持续的场景资产和视觉反馈的支持下,为编码代理指定了必要的结构和动态,同时将外观和精细运动留给视频模型. 实验显示在VTR和R2M上的领先性能,比直接生成的物理可信度有所提高,在长形式结构和连续相互作用的一致性方面有进一步的收益。 在运动自然性、过渡稳定性和坚持场景设置方面仍然存在的差距突出表明,随着视频生成扩展到更长和更复杂的情景,在合成过程中需要更好地保持明确的控制。

blocks.en: A.3 Selective Modeling and Visual Quality
blocks.zh: A.3 选择性建模和视觉质量

blocks.en: The following examples show how simplified proxies can guide the scene while allowing the video model to supply finer appearance and motion. In Figure 19 , the proxy describes the flattening dough and surrounding objects, and the final video adds the hands performing the action. The wheelchair interaction in Figure 21 and the alternating cockpit views in Figure 25 extend this division of work to human movement and expression. Figure 23 provides an object-focused example, tracing the transition from modeled food geometry to the final surface detail.

blocks.en: We implement the three experimental components through explicit instructions to the coding agent and controlled selection of the final generation prompt. The agent constructs and renders Blender proxies under the selected configuration. Across configurations, we preserve task-required entity counts, identities, spatial layout, event order, endpoint states, and camera requirements. Background coverage, lighting, shadows, and rendering settings follow the same policy.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对编码剂的明确指示和对最终生成时的可控选择来实施三个实验组件. 代理在选中的配置下构造并让 Blender 代理 。 在整个配置中,我们保留任务要求的实体计数,身份,空间布局,事件顺序,端点状态,以及相机要求. 背景覆盖、照明、阴影和渲染设置都遵循同样的政策。

blocks.en: The three levels control the geometry and motion of subjects and interaction-relevant objects: • G0 (coarse). Each human is represented by a cylindrical body and a spherical head, without limbs or articulated joints. Animals use simple head and body volumes, and objects primarily use boxes, spheres, or cylinders. Animation represents whole-entity translation and rotation. Invisible logical anchors express possession and object transfer, while task-critical openings or passages may use a few additional primitives. • G1 (medium). Humans have a simple torso, head, and four unsegmented limbs with a fixed relative pose and recognizable front/back orientation. Root motion and interaction objects are animated, but local anatomical articulation is excluded. Objects use small assemblies of primitives that retain their coarse silhouettes, major openings, and necessary supports. Contacts are represented through coarse endpoints or logical anchors. • G2 (fine). Subjects use proportionate segmented bodies and task-relevant articulated joints. Animation explicitly represents local poses, contact, release, support, and visible state changes. Objects include recognizable components, thickness, cavities, openings, and moving parts at the rendered viewing scale. Facial, finger, and clothing geometry is added only when required by the task; refinement focuses on structure and motion rather than surface textures. Task-required material changes, including cloth deformation, liquids, particles, and smoke, are permitted at every granularity level using sufficient simulation geometry. These exceptions do not relax the anatomical articulation limits of G0 and G1 . Revisions remain within the selected granularity.
blocks.zh: 3级控制对象和相互作用相关对象的几何和运动: • G0(粗体). 每个人类由一个圆柱形的身体和一个球形的头部代表,没有四肢或清晰的关节. 动物使用简单的头部和体积,物体主要使用盒子,球体,或圆柱. 动画代表全实体翻译和旋转. 隐形逻辑锚表示拥有和对象转移,而任务关键开口或通道则可能使用一些额外的原始. • G1(中型)。 人类有简单的躯干,头部,以及四条无隔断的四肢,具有固定的相对姿势和可识别的前部/后部方向. 根运动和相互作用对象都是动画,但局部解剖表达被排除. 物体使用小组装的原始物,保留其粗糙的硅胶,主要开口,以及必要的支撑. 联系人通过粗末端点或逻辑锚来表示. • G2(罚款)。 主题采用比例分化的机构以及与任务相关的明确联系。 动画明确代表局部的姿势,接触,发布,支持,以及可见的状态变化. 物体包括可辨认的部件、厚度、腔、开口和按已显示的查看尺度移动的部分。 只有在任务需要时才会添加面部,手指,和服装几何;精细化的重点是结构与运动而非表面纹理. 利用充分的模拟几何,每个颗粒层都允许任务所需的材料改变,包括布的变形、液体、颗粒和烟雾。 这些例外并不放松G0和G1的解剖表达限制. 修订仍在选定的颗粒内。

blocks.en: • P0 (no mandatory simulation). The agent is instructed to produce physically reasonable motion without a mandatory explicit solver. It may use authored trajectories or keyframes. Physics simulation remains permitted when independently selected by the agent. • P1 (explicit simulation). The agent is required to execute task-appropriate physics simulation in Blender. Interacting bodies and boundaries use collision geometry with actual contact, non-penetration, support, and collision response. Cloth motion uses cloth simulation; liquid flow, pouring, and splashing use fluid simulation; discrete grains use particle systems; and airborne dust or smoke uses gas simulation. Only processes relevant to the original task are introduced. Required simulations are executed or baked over the relevant interval, and their evaluated states, deformed meshes, particles, or volumes drive the rendered proxy. Merely configuring a collider or simulation domain is insufficient. The agent records initial conditions, physical parameters, solver settings, and cache paths, together with failed or unsupported simulation attempts.

blocks.en: • PE0 (no enhancement). The original task instruction is retained verbatim as the base generation prompt. Subjects and objects use neutral gray/white proxy materials and are identified through geometry, position, and semantic roles. The controller appends the proxy-interpretation instructions and reference mappings, indicating that final appearance should follow the task and authorized references. • PE1 (independent enhancement). MiniMax H3-Context-IR [ 20 ] receives only the unchanged original dataset prompt, without the proxy, reference media, agent history, or benchmark-added camera and duration instructions. Its complete response becomes the base generation prompt and is reused across revisions of the same run. The proxy retains the neutral gray/white appearance used in PE0 . • PE2 (agent-guided enhancement). Before construction, the coding agent assigns each tracked subject a stable entity identifier, an unambiguous semantic description, and a distinct identity color. Colors remain consistent across frames and changes of possession. After inspecting the proxy, the same agent explicitly states the observed color–subject bindings in the generation prompt. These colors serve as identity markers; final colors and materials follow the original task and references. The agent additionally describes compatible appearance details absent from the proxy, including materials, surface properties, lighting, and natural anatomy or motion. Shot descriptions follow the constructed proxy’s actions, camera behavior, timing, and persistent states. Incorrect represented geometry or motion must be corrected in the proxy before generation. Thus, PE2 jointly changes prompt construction and proxy identity encoding, whereas PE0 and PE1 share the neutral-clay representation.

Each evaluator scores consistency, instruction following, physical plausibility, and naturalness and visual realism on a four-point scale { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } \{0,1,2,3\} , where higher scores indicate better quality. For each video and dimension, we average the scores from the 10 evaluators. Benchmark-level results average these video-level scores over the evaluated samples, and the overall results pool samples from the three benchmarks.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on three complementary benchmarks.
WorldMemBench assesses world consistency during scene revisitation,
including the preservation of identities, object appearances, spatial
geometry, and evolving states.
VGIF-Bench evaluates complex spatio-temporal instruction following,
including entity attributes, actions, interactions, and event ordering.
Principia assesses physical consistency through motion relationships
between paired objects across eight Newtonian phenomena.
For this analysis, we retain only samples that produce valid outputs
under every evaluated configuration, ensuring that all configurations
are compared on the same inputs. This filtering is necessary because
Seedance’s privacy policy prevents some samples from returning valid
results. The resulting evaluation set contains 33 WorldMemBench samples,
29 VGIF-Bench samples, and 32 Principia samples, totaling 94 samples.
Figure 27 shows their distribution.

blocks.en:
We assess generated videos along four dimensions. Consistency measures temporal and cross-shot coherence,
including whether scenes, spatial layouts, character identities,
and object attributes remain consistent except where changes are
explicitly required. It also evaluates fidelity to input reference
images when applicable, such as preserving a specified first frame
or faithfully reproducing the appearance of a reference subject. Instruction following measures whether the video completely
and correctly fulfills the original input requirements, including
events, character actions, interactions, environmental layouts,
lighting, and camera movements, with the specified temporal order
and spatial relationships. Physical plausibility evaluates whether depicted physical
processes visually conform to physical laws, including plausible
trajectories, gravity, collisions, contact, support, and material
responses. Naturalness and visual realism assesses the perceptual
quality of appearance and motion, including plausible anatomy,
fluid movement, and convincing rendering, while penalizing malformed
limbs, stiff or jerky actions, and other visible artifacts.
Ten expert evaluators independently rate the videos along these
dimensions in a blind evaluation, without access to method identities
or configuration labels. Evaluators are provided with the original
instructions and any applicable reference images to assess adherence
and reference fidelity. We report the mean score across the ten
evaluators for each dimension.

blocks.en: Appendix D Prompt Template

blocks.en: The following templates collect the core instructions from the system prompt and workflow skills. Braced fields are filled with task-specific inputs.
blocks.zh: 以下模板收集系统即时和工作流程技能的核心指令. 粗体字段充满任务特定输入.

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { task }, { references } Read the original instruction and inspect the supplied references . Assess whether natural articulated motion is the main challenge and whether a simplified geometric proxy would constrain its quality . Consider expressive body movement , animal gait , and complex articulated motion when natural appearance is central to the task . Identify requirements for explicit control , including exact trajectories , physical interactions , scene revisits , persistent object states , or precise spatial relationships . When these coexist with natural motion , explicit control takes priority . Mark uncertainty explicitly . Return one JSON object with boolean fields natural_motion_primary , proxy_rigidity_risk , requires_explicit_control , and uncertain ; include evidence as exact quotes from the task and a short reason . The controller uses this assessment to select the route .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {任务},{参考} 阅读原指令并检查所提供的参考文献。 评估自然表达的运动是否是主要挑战,以及简化的几何代号是否会限制其质量。 当自然外观是任务的核心时, 确定明确的控制要求,包括准确的轨迹、物理相互作用、场景重访、持续物体状态或精确的空间关系。 当这些与自然运动并存时,明确的控制优先。 明确标示不确定性。 返回一个带有布尔字段的 JSON 对象 : natural_motion_prime , 代理_rididity_risk, 需要_explict_ control, 且不确定 ; 包含来自任务的确切引文和一个短的理由 。 控制器使用此评估来选择路径 。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { task }, { references } Before construction , translate the original task into observable requirements for the finished video . Cover the subjects , relationships , event order , resulting states , and visual qualities that determine success . Select relevant criteria for appearance , action continuity , environment , and physical behavior . For each criterion , record its basis in the task or reference , the expected visible result , the event or interval to inspect , and acceptable variation . Merge repeated checks of the same requirement . Call set_acceptance_criteria with id , category , requirement , basis , check , and tolerance for every criterion . Keep these criteria fixed during repairs . For a new interaction round , register the new requirements together with the states that must persist .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {任务},{参考} 在施工前,将原始任务转化为可观察到的对完成的视频的要求。 包括主题、关系、事件顺序、结果状态以及决定成功的视觉品质。 选择有关外观、动作连续性、环境以及身体行为的标准。 对于每项标准,记录其在任务或参考中的基础、预期可见结果、检查的事件或间隔以及可接受的变异。 合并重复检查同一要求。 调用设置_接受_标准 ID,类别,要求,基础,检查,以及每个标准的容忍度. 在修理期间保持这些标准不变。 与必须坚持下去的各州一起登记新的要求。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { task }, { scene_brief } For a text - only task , call generate_scene_reference to establish the intended scene appearance . Describe the visual medium , major structures , object proportions , occupied space , materials , and lighting . Include required people or animals in their intended locations . View the returned image . Check object counts and spatial relationships as well as appearance , and revise concrete conflicts with the task . Use the inspected reference when constructing the scene , retaining the geometry needed for movement and occlusion . Pass the reference to video_model with an explicit appearance role . Describe time - dependent actions and state changes through the proxy and shot prompts . Reuse the established scene design on later visits .
blocks.zh: QQ 输入 : {任务} ,{ scene_ brief} 对于文本 - 只有任务, 调用生成_ scene_ 引用以建立预期的场景外观 。 描述视觉介质、主要结构、物体比例、占用空间、材料和照明。 包括预定地点的所需人员或动物。 查看返回的图像 。 检查对象计数和空间关系以及外观,并修正与任务的具体冲突。 在构建场景时使用检查过的参考文献,保留移动和隔离所需的几何图形。 传递视频_型号的引用,并带有明确的外观角色. 描述时间 - 依赖动作和状态变化通过代理和shot 提示 。 在以后的访问中重新使用既定的场景设计。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { scene_brief }, { references } Use G1 for environments and objects : build recognizable structures from a small number of geometric parts . Preserve major silhouettes , openings , supports , required counts , and spatial relationships . Allocate geometry according to the views and interactions that the video must show . Use G0 for each human : a cylindrical body and spherical head , animated through whole - body translation and changes in facing direction . Keep this representation consistent through close views and revisions . Use logical anchors to record holding , transfer , and ownership when needed . Preserve the requested event order and resulting states in the proxy . Describe detailed human appearance and fine articulation in the video - generation prompt , supported by the appearance references .
blocks.zh: QQ 输入 : { scene_brief},{参考 } 在环境和对象中使用 G1 : 从少数几何部分建立可识别的结构 。 保存主要硅胶、开口、支持、所需计数和空间关系。 根据视频必须显示的观点和互动来分配几何。 每个人类使用G0:一个圆柱形的身体和球形的头部,通过整部动画——身体翻译和面对方向的变化. 通过密切的意见和修订,保持这一表述的一致性。 使用逻辑锁定来记录持有,转让,以及必要时的所有权 。 保存请求的事件顺序, 并在代理中生成状态 。 在影片中详细描述人类的外貌和精细的表达,

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { scene }, { required_physical_events } Identify the physical interactions that determine the requested outcome . Choose appropriate simulation mechanisms and construct the geometry needed for collision , contact , support , or containment . Configure initial conditions and the simulation interval from the task . Execute or bake the simulation over that interval . Use its evaluated geometry , particles , or volumes in the proxy video so the rendered sequence shows the simulated evolution . Inspect the interaction from the actual camera views , including the approach , contact , and resulting motion or state . Correct visible failures in the scene or simulation and render the affected interval again before submitting the proxy for video synthesis .
blocks.zh: QQ 输入 : { scene},{ required_physical_events} 识别决定所请求的结果的物理交互. 选择适当的模拟机制,并构建碰撞、接触、支持或遏制所需的几何。 配置初始条件和任务模拟间隔 。 执行或烤 模拟的时间间隔。 使用其评价的几何、粒子或代理视频中的卷数,使渲染的序列显示模拟演化。 检查实际摄像头视图的相互作用,包括方法、联系方式以及由此产生的运动或状态。 校正场景或模拟中可见的故障,并在提交视频合成代理之前再次使受影响的间隔。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { scene_plan }, { component_scope } Establish the coarse scene layout before delegating components . Split work where independent construction and review are useful . For each child task , provide the component ’ s scope , dimensions , origin , connection points , required detail , and views used for inspection . Submit independent components together through delegate_tasks . Reuse shared meshes or collection instances for repeated assets . Ask children to return editable scene assets and their construction sources . Load the returned assets into the parent scene and inspect their scale , placement , and connections . When a correction is needed , use resume_task with concrete feedback and updated views so the responsible child can continue from its existing assets and conversation .
blocks.zh: * 输入 : { scene_ plan},{ 组件_scope} 在授权组件之前建立粗糙的场景布局 。 独立施工和审查有用的工作分开进行。 对于每个儿童任务,请提供组成部分的范围、尺寸、来源、联系点、所需详细情况以及用于检查的意见。 通过代理任务一起提交独立的组件 。 重复使用 meshes 或重复资产的收集实例。 请孩子们返回可编辑的场景资产及其建筑来源。 将返回的资产装入母场并检查其规模、位置和连接。 当需要更正时,请使用带有具体反馈和最新意见的恢复任务,以便负责儿童能够继续利用其现有资产和对话。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { scene_plan }, { component_assets } Assemble the assets according to the planned layout . Verify their bounds and origins before placement , and preserve required instance counts , spacing , and occupied areas . Inspect overview and camera previews to find missing structures or obstructed action paths . Animate persistent entities on a continuous scene timeline . Record each object ’ s location , holder or support , and visible state before and after the relevant events . Carry completed changes through camera cuts and periods outside the frame . For revisits , evaluate the same scene at the later time . Preview important contacts , releases , and later outcomes from the actual cameras , then correct missing or ambiguous events before rendering the complete proxy .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {场景_计划},{组件_资产} 按照计划布局汇总资产. 在放置前核实它们的界限和起源,并保存必要的实例数、间隔和占用区。 检查概览和相机预览以找到缺失的结构或阻碍动作路径 。 在连续的场景时间线上激活持续实体。 记录每个对象的位置、持有者或支持,在有关事件前后的可见状态。 通过照相机的剪切和帧外的时段进行已完成的更改。 重新检讨, 预览重要联系人, 释放,

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { assembled_scene }, { shot_requirements } Plan the camera together with geometry and action timing . Decide what each shot should reveal and preserve requested fixed views , movement directions , cuts , and continuous takes . Choose travel speed according to scene scale and the intended pace . Specify each move ’ s duration , travel distance or orbit angle , framing target , and speed profile . Carry motion through adjacent shots when appropriate , and retain the endpoint camera state for continuation . Render previews along the actual path . Inspect framing and clearance throughout the move , with denser checks around contacts , occlusions , and cuts . For a return to an earlier view , compare visible landmarks and framing with the saved accepted frame while retaining the current scene state .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {组装_scene},{shot_requiments} 计划相机与几何和动作时间。 决定每一镜头应该揭示和保存所请求的固定视图、移动方向、切片和持续拍摄。 根据场景尺度和预定速度选择旅行速度。 指定每次移动的持续时间、旅行距离或轨道角度、设定目标和速度简介。 酌情通过相邻镜头移动 并保留端点摄像头状态 沿实际路径预览 。 检查整个行动过程, 将可见的地标与已保存的已接受框架进行对比,

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { subjects }, { appearance_references } Register each recurring subject with a stable subject_id and identity description . Record clothing or appearance variants separately from temporary actions and states . Have delegated tasks retrieve and reuse the registered subject . Inspect and bind the selected appearance references . Use the same subject_id in the scene and shot manifest , including when the subject leaves and returns . Specify the applicable appearance version and temporary state in each shot when they change . In the video prompt , explicitly connect each subject ’ s proxy identity color to its reference appearance . Explain that the color identifies the subject and that the intended final appearance follows the task and reference . Reuse these bindings throughout the video .
blocks.zh: QQ 输入 : {主题}, {外观_参考} 注册每个反复出现的主题, 并有一个稳定的主题_ 标识和身份描述 。 记录服装或外观的变体与临时行动和状态分开 已授权任务检索和重用注册对象 。 检查并绑定选中的外观引用 。 在现场使用相同的主题_id并拍摄显示,包括主体离开和返回时. 指定每次镜头更改时适用的外观版本和临时状态 。 在视频提示中, 解释颜色确定主题,预定最终外观遵循任务和参考。 重新使用这些捆绑 整个视频。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { task }, { inspected_proxy }, { references } Inspect the proxy and reference media before writing a self - contained prompt for the complete video . Begin with the intended finished appearance , explain the role of each reference , and describe the shots in temporal order . Bind every recurring subject to its proxy identity color and appearance reference . Use the proxy to specify layout , trajectories , camera motion , contact , and event timing . Describe the natural anatomy , local articulation , and surface appearance that the video model should synthesize . Preserve state changes across shots and specify what should remain visible after an event . Correct wrong geometry , motion , or outcomes in the proxy before synthesis . Inspect the generated video at corresponding moments to locate any failures requiring revision .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {任务},{检查过的_代理}, {参考} 在撰写自己之前先检查代理媒体和参考媒体, 并按时间顺序描述镜头。 绑定每个反复出现的主题 与其代理身份颜色和外观参考 。 使用代理指定布局、轨迹、相机运动、联系人和事件时间 。 描述视频模型应合成的自然解剖、局部表达和表面外观。 保留状态在镜头间变化, 在合成前纠正错误的几何、运动或代用结果 。 在相应时刻检查生成的视频,以找到任何需要修改的故障。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { task }, { references } For a task routed to direct generation , register acceptance criteria and prepare a compact action plan . Specify who acts , how the movement develops , the important contacts , the outcome , and camera framing . Preserve the roles of supplied reference media . Write a self - contained generation prompt and call video_model with the requested duration , references , proxy_video = null , and shot_manifest_path = null . Retain the returned job and revision identifiers ; resume the same submission while its content is unchanged . Inspect the downloaded video and record concrete findings with record_video_review . Request independent acceptance , then revise the action plan , prompt , or references as required . Deliver the inspected result through finish using its render_uuid .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {任务},{参考} 用于指导生成、登记接受标准和编制紧凑行动计划的任务。 具体说明谁的行为、运动的发展方式、重要联系人、结果和照相机布局。 保留所提供的参考媒体的作用。 写入自定义 - 包含生成即时和调用视频_ 模式, 包含请求的持续时间 , 参考文献 , 代理_ video = 无效, 和 shot_ manifest_ path = 无效 。 保留返回的工作和修订标识符;在内容不变的情况下恢复相同的提交。 检查下载的视频, 要求独立接受,然后修订行动计划,及时,或按要求参考。 完成检查结果的提交。

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { next_instruction }, { scene_checkpoint }, { previous_video } Load the established scene , scripts , and subject identities . Continue from the latest accumulated object and camera states . Preserve completed changes , including events that occurred outside the camera view . Inspect the accepted video ’ s endpoint and use it to guide the next opening . Select the previous video or tail frame and the updated proxy as required by the generation interface , declaring each reference ’ s role . Keep the established appearance references across segments . Generate the current segment and inspect the transition from the preceding video . Check the camera view , subject identity , and ongoing action around the boundary . Save the updated scene checkpoint and event states for the next continuation .
blocks.zh: 输入 : {下一个_指示},{现场_检查点}, {上个视频} 装入既定的场景、脚本和主题身份。 从最近累积的对象和相机状态继续 。 保存完成的更改,包括镜头视图外发生的事件。 并用它来指导下一次开幕。 根据生成界面的要求,选择先前的视频或尾框以及更新的代理,声明每个引用的角色. 将既定的外观参考资料保留在各段之间。 生成当前段并检查从上一个视频的过渡 。 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) 保存更新的场景检查点和事件状态,

blocks.en: ⬇ Inputs : { original_task }, { acceptance_criteria }, { candidate_video } Independently inspect the actual candidate against every registered criterion . Cover the sequence and examine key actions , transitions , and resulting states . View short continuous intervals for motion quality and collect additional views when evidence is unclear . Assign pass when a requirement is satisfied , minor for an acceptable localized defect , rework for a failure requiring correction , or unverified when the available evidence is insufficient . Ground each judgment in timestamped visual observations . For rework , describe the visible failure and the required correction . Call submit_video_acceptance with the criterion checks and a summary so the generating agent can revise the relevant content .
